```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db")
listings     = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings") |> tibble::as_tibble()
availability = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "availability_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
reviews      = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "reviews_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```
## Task 1
```{r}
host_counts <- listings |>
  dplyr::count(host_id, name = "n_listings")

A1 <- host_counts |>
  dplyr::filter(n_listings >= 10) |>
  nrow()

A2 <- listings |>
  dplyr::left_join(host_counts, by = "host_id") |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Chicago") |>
  dplyr::summarize(pct = 100 * mean(n_listings >= 10))

A1
A2
```
## Task 2
```{r}
A3 <- listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    accommodates >= 4,
    number_of_reviews >= 10,
    review_scores_rating >= 4.8
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(price_per_person = price / accommodates) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, neighbourhood) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    median_pp = median(price_per_person),
    n = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus", n >= 20) |>
  dplyr::arrange(median_pp) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 1)

A3
```
## Task 3
```{r}
A4 <- listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, room_type) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    dplyr::across(
      c(price, reviews_per_month, estimated_revenue_l365d),
      ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    city == "Twin Cities",
    room_type == "Entire home/apt"
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(estimated_revenue_l365d)

A4
```
## Task 4
```{r}
A5 <- listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(top10 = dplyr::row_number() <= ceiling(.10 * dplyr::n())) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    pct_revenue = 100 *
      sum(estimated_revenue_l365d[top10], na.rm = TRUE) /
      sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus")

A5
```
## Task 5
```{r}
A6_A7 <- availability |>
  dplyr::filter(month == "2026-10") |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    listings |>
      dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |>
      dplyr::select(id, city),
    by = "id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    share = 100 * mean(nights_available < .5 * nights_in_month),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(share) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 1)

A6_A7
```
## Task 6
```{r}
tc_months <- reviews |>
  dplyr::filter(month >= "2025-07", month <= "2026-06") |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    listings |>
      dplyr::select(id, city),
    by = "id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities") |>
  dplyr::group_by(month) |>
  dplyr::summarize(total_reviews = sum(reviews), .groups = "drop")

A8 <- tc_months |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(total_reviews)) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 1)

A9 <- tc_months |>
  dplyr::summarize(ratio = max(total_reviews) / min(total_reviews))

A8
A9
```
## Task 7
```{r}
task7 <- listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    !is.na(host_is_superhost)
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, host_is_superhost) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

task7

premiums <- task7 |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    premium =
      median_price[host_is_superhost == "t"] -
      median_price[host_is_superhost == "f"],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

premiums
```

## Task 9
```{r}
host_counts <- listings |>
  dplyr::count(host_id, name = "n_listings")

listing_share <- listings |>
  dplyr::left_join(host_counts, by = "host_id") |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    pct_listings_10plus = 100 * mean(n_listings >= 10),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

listing_share

revenue_share <- listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    top10 = dplyr::row_number() <= ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n())
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    pct_revenue_top10 = 100 *
      sum(estimated_revenue_l365d[top10], na.rm = TRUE) /
      sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

revenue_share

B2_numbers <- listing_share |>
  dplyr::left_join(revenue_share, by = "city")

B2_numbers
```
